scope.controller_templates: Deployment, StatefulSet and DaemonSet; CronJob separately listed. Excludes completed Jobs and custom operators from template denominator.
scope.active_pods: Running or Pending; excludes terminating. Container counts include regular containers only, not init or ephemeral containers.
scope.coverage: Direct VPA targetRef matching a long-running controller; not proof of admission, eviction, or matching pods.
scope.memory_history: Seven-day peak sampled by Prometheus for selected namespaces and pods present at snapshot; missing is unknown and current-pod age may be shorter than seven days.
scope.privacy: Sanitized names, resource values, modes and summarized metrics only; no raw API payloads, Secret values, container environments, logs or identities.

attic.vpa: Recreate, RequestsOnly, singleton protected by default minimum 2

collection.cluster_snapshot: kubectl get vpa, deployments, statefulsets, daemonsets, cronjobs, jobs, pods, namespaces, HPA, PDB, nodes, CNPG clusters and metrics.k8s.io; collected approximately 02:58 UTC
collection.node_requests: kubectl describe nodes, allocated resources / allocatable; metrics-server usage from metrics.k8s.io nodes
collection.seven_day_method: Mimir instant query max by(namespace,pod,container) (max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~<selected namespaces>,container!="",container!="POD"}[7d])). The inventory joins only pods present in the snapshot.

seven_day_queries.group: Flux, Attic, Agentplane, Piraeus, CSI, Atuin, Authentik and Forgejo

collection.oom_method: Running pods with lastState.terminated.reason=OOMKilled in Kubernetes pod snapshot; only last termination per container retained. Follow-up sample checked readiness and memory.
